name: io.github.AshutoshRaj97/agentready-mcp
description: Query any website's documentation with cited, multi-page answers. Submit any public URL and ask questions in natural language — AgentReady indexes developer tools, APIs, cloud platforms, frameworks, databases, and more. Handles JS-rendered SPAs that web_fetch cannot read. Tools: list_sites, ask_site, submit_site, refresh_site.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTREADY_MCP_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the MCP endpoint URL (only needed for self-hosted AgentReady instances)
